title: Activity restarts the idle clock
text: The transition `expire` has `delayed(30000)` and needs the `session` token, and `touch` takes that token and puts it back whenever there is `activity`. Between the two halves of the firing of `touch` the place `session` is empty, so `expire` loses its clock and starts a fresh one: the 30 seconds count from the last activity.

steps.text: At 10 s the user types. The transition `expire` has been armed since 0 ms and has 20 s to go.

The transition `touch` takes `session` and puts it back in one firing. `expire` is not enabled in between, so it loses its clock; it is enabled again at once and its clock restarts at 10 s (`TransitionClockRestarted`).
No more activity: `expire` fires at 40 s, 30 s after the restart, not at 30 s.
